en: Back to the Future Part III
orig: Back to the Future Part III
ov: العودة إلى المستقبل 3 (الإنجليزية: Back to the Future Part III)، هي الجزء الثالث والأخير من سلسلة العودة إلى المستقبل، وهي من صنف الخيال العلمي والكوميدية والغرب الأمريكي، أنتجت سنة 1990م، وشارك فيه مايكل جاي فوكس وكرستوفر لويد،
plotEn:
On November 12, 1955, moments after witnessing Emmett "Doc" Brown disappear in his DeLorean, Marty McFly learns that Doc was sent 70 years into the past to 1885. Using information from Doc's 1885 letter, Marty and the 1955 Doc find and repair the DeLorean, hidden away by Doc in 1885, so that Marty can return to 1985. After finding it, Marty comes across a tombstone inscribed with Doc's name, erected by the town's then-new schoolteacher Clara Clayton, stating that Doc was killed by Biff Tannen's great-grandfather, Buford "Mad Dog" Tannen, over 80 dollars, six days after writing the letter.
Despite the letter's warning, Marty travels to September 2, 1885, to save Doc, arriving in the middle of a cavalry pursuit of Native Americans. Marty evades the pursuit, but damages the car's fuel line. Chased by a bear, he is knocked unconscious and found by his Irish-born great-great-grandparents Seamus and Maggie McFly, who allow him to stay the night. The next morning, under the alias Clint Eastwood, Marty arrives in a newly founded Hill Valley but runs afoul of Buford and his gang. Doc rescues Marty from Buford's attempted lynching. Doc agrees to leave 1885 after learning his fate, but without gasoline, the DeLorean cannot reach 88 miles per hour (142 kilometers per hour) to time-travel. He proposes using a steam locomotive to push the DeLorean to that speed.
